skill.name: improve-animations
skill.description: Audits animation and motion code, prioritizes issues, and creates self-contained implementation plans. An optional execute mode delegates plan implementation to another agent.

security_audit.summary: All 27 static findings are false positives caused by code-formatted prose, CSS examples, read-only search guidance, or a defensive prompt-injection rule. Publication should disclose and constrain this mode.

remediation.issue: The execute and reconcile variants conflict with the stated read-only boundary.
remediation.suggestion: Remove mutating variants or revise the description and hard rules to require explicit approval before any delegated source changes.

remediation.issue: Delegated execution lacks explicit command, permission, and cleanup boundaries.
remediation.suggestion: Document allowed operations, require diff review, prohibit credential access, and define isolated worktree cleanup before offering execute mode.

content.user_title: Improve Product Animations With Actionable Plans
content.value_statement: Inconsistent motion can make interfaces feel slow, distracting, or inaccessible. This skill audits animation code and produces prioritized findings with detailed implementation plans.
actual_capabilities: Maps frameworks, motion libraries, animation tokens, interactive components, and usage frequency.
Audits purpose, timing, physicality, interruptibility, performance, accessibility, cohesion, and missed opportunities.
Verifies findings against cited source lines and ranks them by impact and effort.
Creates plans with file excerpts, exact target values, ordered steps, boundaries, and verification checks.
Supports quick, standard, deep, and category-focused audit scopes.
Can delegate selected plan execution to another agent in an isolated worktree.
limitations: Source analysis cannot reliably judge visual feel, so plans require manual feel checks.
The default workflow writes plan files and does not apply application source changes.
Execute mode delegates source changes and requires independent diff review before acceptance.
Recommendations follow the included audit catalog and may not match every product motion language.

use_cases.title: Prepare a frontend refinement sprint
use_cases.description: Audit interactive motion, rank issues by leverage, and create plans for selected fixes.

use_cases.title: Standardize a motion system
use_cases.description: Find inconsistent easing, duration, spring, and reduced-motion patterns across shared components.

use_cases.title: Delegate animation improvements
use_cases.description: Convert motion findings into scoped plans that another agent can implement and verify.

prompt_templates.title: Run a standard audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this repository's animations at standard depth. Present verified findings with file locations, then wait for my plan selections.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this for a first motion review of an application.

prompt_templates.title: Focus on accessibility
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit motion accessibility. Check reduced-motion behavior, hover gating, and essential feedback. Rank confirmed issues and plan my selected findings.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this before an accessibility review or release.

prompt_templates.title: Plan one improvement
prompt_templates.prompt: Create one self-contained plan to make the command palette open instantly. Inspect repository conventions and include exact boundaries and verification steps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this when the desired animation change is already known.

prompt_templates.title: Audit and prepare delegation
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a deep performance and cohesion audit. Plan the four highest-leverage findings, including dependencies, execution order, and feel checks.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this to prepare detailed work for another implementation agent.

output_examples.input: Audit animations in this dashboard at standard depth.
output: High: The keyboard-opened command palette animates on every use, delaying a frequent action.
Medium: Several popovers lack reduced-motion alternatives.
Next: Select findings one, two, or three for detailed plans.

output_examples.input: Write a plan for the inconsistent dropdown entrance.
output: Plan 004 targets the dropdown entrance across two components.
The plan specifies the repository easing token, timing, transform origin, and reduced-motion behavior.
Verification covers rapid toggling, slow playback, and keyboard interaction.
High: A frequently updated panel animates layout properties and can trigger repeated layout work.
Medium: Broad transitions can animate unintended properties.
The report separates confirmed performance issues from items requiring visual measurement.

best_practices: Choose quick, standard, or deep scope based on repository size and available review time.
Share the product personality and highest-frequency interactions before the audit.
Review and select findings before generating plans or delegating implementation.
anti_patterns: Do not request broad animation fixes without defining scope or interaction priorities.
Do not treat source analysis as complete visual validation.
Do not run execute mode without explicit approval and independent diff review.

faq.question: Does this skill edit application source files?
faq.answer: The default workflow edits only plan files. Execute mode delegates source changes to another agent and requires review.

faq.question: Which audit scopes are available?
faq.answer: Quick covers high-traffic components, standard covers interactive UI, and deep covers the full repository.

faq.question: Which animation technologies are supported?
faq.answer: The workflow inspects CSS, WAAPI, Framer Motion, React Spring, GSAP, and repository-specific motion systems.

faq.question: Does the audit cover accessibility?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks reduced-motion behavior, hover gating, and whether essential visual feedback remains available.

faq.question: Can source code reveal whether an animation feels right?
faq.answer: Not always. The skill marks uncertain judgments and adds slow-motion, frame-by-frame, or real-device feel checks.

faq.question: What does the skill produce?
faq.answer: It produces prioritized findings, missed opportunities, detailed plan documents, execution order, dependencies, and verification criteria.
